records.text: in a "Karen" tone please write a rejection letter to "The Windchill Server" for poor speed, spotty connection and generally distasteful attitude towards the engineering staff

Dear Windchill Server,

I am writing to inform you that your services are no longer needed by our engineering team. The speed and connection you have provided have been consistently poor and your attitude towards our staff has been nothing short of distasteful. We expect more from our servers and will be seeking alternative options.

Sincerely,
Karen
instead of karen now do "concerned user" and rather than outright rejection it should request improved service and serversSave & SubmitCancel

Dear Windchill Server,

I am writing as a concerned user to bring to your attention some issues that have been affecting the performance of your service. Specifically, the speed and connection provided have been spotty and unreliable, causing significant delays and frustration for our engineering team.

I understand that these issues may not be entirely within your control, but I hope that you will take them seriously and take steps to improve the service and upgrade the servers. Our team relies heavily on the functionality and performance of your service, and we cannot continue to operate effectively with these problems.

I would appreciate any updates or information you can provide regarding the steps you are taking to address these issues.

Thank you for your attention.

Sincerely,
Concerned User
good now be a little more sassy

Dear Windchill Server,

Listen up, because I've got some issues to bring to your attention. Your speed and connection have been as reliable as a teenager's promise to do the dishes. Our engineering team has been dealing with delays and frustration thanks to your spotty service.

Now, I know you might not be able to control everything, but you better believe we expect better. It's time to step up your game, upgrade those servers and provide the reliable service we're paying for.

Don't think we're just going to sit around twiddling our thumbs while you figure it out, we need solutions and we need them now.

Sincerely,
A Sassily Concerned User

proposal.rationale: The user directly stated (m_0001:0) that their engineering team suffers from the Windchill Server's poor speed and spotty connection, plus a jokingly cited 'distasteful attitude' toward the staff — a durable, host-neutral workplace fact. The subsequent requests (m_0003:0, m_0005:0) only changed the letters' tone (concerned user, sassy) and framing (rejection → request for improved service/servers), not the underlying facts, so no separate update entries are warranted. No secrets, temporary task state, or assistant claims are included.

edits.title: Windchill server: poor speed and spotty connection frustrating user's engineering team (reported 2023-12-06)
edits.content: The user works with an engineering team whose 'Windchill Server' delivers poor speed and a spotty connection, causing delays and frustration for the team; the user also jokingly cited its 'generally distasteful attitude towards the engineering staff' (stated 2023-12-06). These grievances were the premise for a series of humorous complaint letters the user requested: first a rejection letter in a 'Karen' tone, then a revised 'concerned user' letter requesting improved service and server upgrades, then a sassy version. The letters were creative writing exercises — the underlying workplace complaints (slow, unreliable Windchill server affecting the engineering team) were stated by the user. No actual service change, upgrade, or migration was decided in the conversation.
edits.reason: Direct user statement of a durable, host-neutral workplace fact (engineering team hampered by a slow, unreliable Windchill server) that can inform future work-related conversations; tone changes mid-conversation were stylistic, not factual updates, so a single entry suffices.

proposal.expectedOutcome: Future conversations about the user's work environment, engineering tooling, or IT issues can recall that their team's Windchill server was slow with an unreliable connection as of 2023-12-06; if the server is later fixed or replaced, a new dated entry can record that change without merging.
